Package Index

Fitting Models

The two model-fitting functions. nbreg() fits negative binomial regression for overdispersed counts; zinbreg() fits zero-inflated negative binomial regression for counts with excess zeros, with a two-part formula y ~ count covariates | zero covariates.

nbreg()
Negative Binomial Regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson
zinbreg()
Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial Regression by EM with IRLS M-Steps

Control Settings

Tolerances, iteration limits, progress tracing and (for ZINB) the Hessian method, passed to the fitting functions as control.

nbreg_control()
Control Settings for nbreg()
zinbreg_control()
Control Settings for zinbreg()

Methods for Fitted Models

What you can do with a fit: print and summarize it, extract coefficients, the covariance matrix, the log-likelihood (with AIC() and BIC()), fitted values and residuals, and predict for new data.

print(<nbreg>) summary(<nbreg>) print(<summary.nbreg>) coef(<nbreg>) vcov(<nbreg>) logLik(<nbreg>) fitted(<nbreg>) residuals(<nbreg>) nobs(<nbreg>) predict(<nbreg>)
Summaries, Predictions and Other Methods for nbreg Fits
print(<zinbreg>) summary(<zinbreg>) print(<summary.zinbreg>) coef(<zinbreg>) vcov(<zinbreg>) logLik(<zinbreg>) fitted(<zinbreg>) residuals(<zinbreg>) nobs(<zinbreg>) predict(<zinbreg>)
Summaries, Predictions and Other Methods for zinbreg Fits

Inference

Confidence intervals, likelihood-ratio tests of nested models, the overdispersion test, and the comparison of a zero-inflated fit with a negative binomial fit.

confint(<nbreg>) print(<nbzinbreg_confint>) confint(<zinbreg>)
Confidence Intervals for nbreg and zinbreg Fits
anova(<nbreg>) anova(<zinbreg>) print(<nbzinbreg_anova>)
Likelihood-Ratio Tests for Nested nbreg or zinbreg Fits
overdispersion_test()
Test for Overdispersion: Poisson against Negative Binomial
vuong_test() print(<nbzinbreg_vuong>)
Compare a zinbreg Fit with an nbreg Fit

Simulation and Bootstrap

Simulate new responses from a fitted model, and parametric bootstrap standard errors.

simulate(<nbreg>) simulate(<zinbreg>)
Simulate Responses from nbreg and zinbreg Fits
boot_se() print(<nbzinbreg_boot>)
Parametric Bootstrap Standard Errors

Diagnostics

Check the fit at every count: observed against expected frequencies, as a table or as a hanging rootogram.

expected_counts()
Observed and Expected Count Frequencies
rootogram()
Rootogram of Observed and Expected Count Frequencies

Tidiers

The coefficient table and the model summary as data frames, in the style of the broom package.

tidy(<nbreg>) glance(<nbreg>) tidy(<zinbreg>) glance(<zinbreg>)
Tidy Summaries of nbreg and zinbreg Fits

Package

An overview of the package, and the tidy() and glance() generics, which are re-exported from the generics package.

nbzinbreg nbzinbreg-package
nbzinbreg: Negative Binomial and Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial Regression
